theory.overview: Advanced DP extends fundamentals to more complex patterns: interval DP (subarrays/substrings), knapsack variants, DP on trees, DP with bitmask, DP on graphs, and optimization techniques. These patterns solve harder problems like palindrome partitioning, matrix chain multiplication, traveling salesman, and tree DP. This chapter covers advanced DP patterns, state compression, and optimization techniques.

sections.title: Interval DP
sections.content: DP on intervals/subarrays. State: dp[l][r] = answer for subarray from l to r. Process intervals by increasing length. Examples: matrix chain multiplication (minimum scalar multiplications), palindrome partitioning (minimum cuts), burst balloons. Complexity typically $O(n^3)$ for interval DP.
sections.pattern: dp[l][r] = combine(dp[l][k], dp[k+1][r]) for k in [l, r-1]

sections.title: Knapsack Variants
sections.content: 0/1 knapsack: each item used at most once. Unbounded knapsack: unlimited use. Bounded knapsack: limited copies. Multiple knapsack: multiple constraints. Fractional knapsack: greedy (not DP). Each variant has different DP formulation.

sections.title: DP with Bitmask
sections.content: Use bitmask to represent subset state. dp[mask] = answer for subset represented by mask. Used for TSP, subset problems, assignment problems. State space: $O(2^n)$. Used when n ≤ 20-25 due to exponential state space.
sections.pattern: dp[mask] = combine(dp[mask without bit], contribution of bit)

sections.title: DP on Trees
sections.content: DP on tree structures. State: dp[node] = answer for subtree rooted at node. Post-order traversal (process children first). Examples: tree diameter, maximum path sum, independent set on tree. Time: $O(n)$ for linear tree DP.
sections.pattern: dp[node] = combine(dp[child] for child in children)

sections.title: DP Optimization
sections.content: Convex hull optimization: optimize DP of form dp[i] = min(dp[j] + cost(j,i)) where cost satisfies quadrangle inequality. Divide and conquer DP: optimize DP with monotone opt property. Knuth optimization: for DP with quadrangle inequality and monotonicity. These reduce $O(n^2)$ to $O(n \log n)$ or $O(n)$.

keyConcepts.name: State Compression
keyConcepts.description: Represent complex state with compact encoding (bitmask, hashing). Essential for problems with exponential state space.
keyConcepts.example: Bitmask for subset: mask has bit i set if element i in subset

keyConcepts.name: Monotonicity
keyConcepts.description: Optimal transition point moves monotonically. Enables divide and conquer or Knuth optimization.
keyConcepts.property: opt[i] ≤ opt[i+1] for optimal transition point

keyConcepts.name: Quadrangle Inequality
keyConcepts.description: Cost function satisfies w(a,c) + w(b,d) ≤ w(a,d) + w(b,c) for a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d. Enables Knuth optimization.

keyConcepts.name: Tree DP Order
keyConcepts.description: Process children before parent (post-order). DP at node depends on children's DP results.

steps.title: Identify Pattern
steps.description: Recognize DP pattern: interval, knapsack, bitmask, tree, etc.

steps.title: Define State
steps.description: Define state parameters. For interval: dp[l][r]. For bitmask: dp[mask].

steps.title: Define Transition
steps.description: Write recurrence. How to compute current state from previous states.

steps.title: Optimize if Possible
steps.description: Check for optimization opportunities: monotonicity, convex hull, etc.

steps.title: Implement
steps.description: Implement with appropriate order (bottom-up) or memoization (top-down).

practiceProblems.title: Matrix Chain Multiplication
practiceProblems.description: Minimum scalar multiplications to multiply matrix chain.
practiceProblems.solution: Interval DP. dp[l][r] = min(dp[l][k] + dp[k+1][r] + dims[l-1]*dims[k]*dims[r]).
practiceProblems.hints: dp[l][r] = min over k of dp[l][k] + dp[k+1][r] + cost

practiceProblems.title: Burst Balloons
practiceProblems.description: Maximum coins by bursting balloons optimally.
practiceProblems.solution: Interval DP. Add 1 at boundaries. dp[l][r] = max(dp[l][k] + dp[k+1][r] + nums[l-1]*nums[k]*nums[r+1]).

practiceProblems.title: Palindrome Partitioning II
practiceProblems.description: Minimum cuts to partition string into palindromes.
practiceProblems.solution: dp[i] = min cuts for s[0:i]. Precompute palindrome table. dp[i] = min(dp[j] + 1) if s[j:i] is palindrome.

practiceProblems.title: 0/1 Knapsack
practiceProblems.description: Maximum value with weight limit (each item once).
practiceProblems.solution: dp[w] = max(dp[w], dp[w-weight] + value). Process items one by one.

practiceProblems.title: Unbounded Knapsack
practiceProblems.description: Maximum value with unlimited item use.
practiceProblems.solution: dp[w] = max(dp[w], dp[w-weight] + value). Same as 0/1 but process w in increasing order.
practiceProblems.hints: Process w in increasing order (unlimited use)

practiceProblems.title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets
practiceProblems.description: Check if array can be partitioned into k subsets with equal sum.
practiceProblems.solution: Backtracking with memoization or DP with bitmask.
practiceProblems.hints: Backtracking with memoization or bitmask DP

practiceProblems.title: Travelling Salesman
practiceProblems.description: Minimum distance to visit all cities and return to start.
practiceProblems.solution: DP with bitmask. dp[mask][i] = min distance to visit cities in mask ending at i.
practiceProblems.hints: dp[mask][i] = min distance to visit mask ending at i

practiceProblems.title: Assign Cookies
practiceProblems.description: Max children content with greed factor and cookie size.
practiceProblems.solution: Sort both, greedy two pointers (not DP).

practiceProblems.title: Partition Array Into K Subsets
practiceProblems.description: Partition array into k subsets with equal sum.
practiceProblems.solution: Backtracking with memoization or DP with bitmask.

practiceProblems.title: Scramble String
practiceProblems.description: Check if s2 is scrambled string of s1.
practiceProblems.solution: Interval DP. dp[i][j][len] = if s1[i:i+len] can form s2[j:j+len].

practiceProblems.title: Remove Boxes
practiceProblems.description: Maximum points by removing boxes (consecutive same color = k^2 points).
practiceProblems.solution: DP with additional parameter for consecutive count. dp[l][r][k] = max points for l..r with k consecutive boxes of same color as r.

practiceProblems.title: Minimum Cost to Cut Stick
practiceProblems.description: Minimum cost to cut stick at given positions.
practiceProblems.solution: Interval DP. dp[l][r] = min cost to cut between positions l and r.

practiceProblems.title: Strange Printer
practiceProblems.description: Minimum turns to print string (printer can print sequence of same character).
practiceProblems.solution: Interval DP. dp[i][j] = min turns to print s[i:j+1].

practiceProblems.title: Minimum Score Triangulation of Polygon
practiceProblems.description: Minimum score triangulation of polygon (score = product of triangle vertices).
practiceProblems.solution: Interval DP. dp[i][j] = min score to triangulate polygon from i to j.

practiceProblems.title: Cherry Pickup
practiceProblems.description: Max cherries collected by two paths from (0,0) to (n-1,n-1).
practiceProblems.solution: DP with two paths moving simultaneously. dp[r1][c1][c2] where r1 + c1 = r2 + c2.

practiceProblems.title: Dungeon Game
practiceProblems.description: Minimum initial health to reach princess in dungeon.
practiceProblems.solution: DP from end to start. dp[i][j] = min health needed starting from (i,j).

practiceProblems.title: Regular Expression Matching
practiceProblems.description: Check if string matches pattern with '.' and '*'.
practiceProblems.solution: DP. dp[i][j] = if s[0:i] matches p[0:j]. Handle '*' specially.

practiceProblems.title: Wildcard Matching
practiceProblems.description: Check if string matches pattern with '?' and '*'.
practiceProblems.solution: DP. dp[i][j] = if s[0:i] matches p[0:j]. '*' can match empty or one+ characters.

practiceProblems.title: Distinct Subsequences II
practiceProblems.description: Number of distinct subsequences (count, not just length).
practiceProblems.solution: DP with last occurrence tracking to avoid duplicates.
practiceProblems.hints: Track last occurrence to avoid duplicates

practiceProblems.title: Count Different Palindromic Subsequences
practiceProblems.description: Count distinct palindromic subsequences.
practiceProblems.solution: Interval DP. dp[l][r] = count of distinct palindromic subsequences in s[l:r+1].

practiceProblems.title: Minimum ASCII Delete Sum
practiceProblems.description: Minimum delete sum to make two strings equal.
practiceProblems.solution: DP similar to edit distance but only delete operations.

practiceProblems.title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
practiceProblems.description: Length of longest palindromic subsequence.
practiceProblems.solution: dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1] + 2 if s[i]==s[j] else max(dp[i+1][j], dp[i][j-1]).
practiceProblems.hints: dp[i][j] = dp[i+1][j-1] + 2 if match else max

practiceProblems.title: Shortest Common Supersequence
practiceProblems.description: Shortest string that has both s1 and s2 as subsequences.
practiceProblems.solution: Use LCS. SCS length = m + n - LCS length. Construct from LCS.

practiceProblems.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock IV
practiceProblems.description: Max profit with at most k transactions.
practiceProblems.solution: DP. dp[t][i] = max profit with t transactions up to day i.

practiceProblems.title: Count Palindromic Substrings
practiceProblems.description: Count palindromic substrings (contiguous).
practiceProblems.solution: DP or expand around center. dp[i][j] = true if s[i]==s[j] and (j-i<3 or dp[i+1][j-1]).

minigame.description: Master advanced DP patterns! Interval, bitmask, and tree DP.
